title: LegalBench.PT: A Benchmark for Portuguese Law

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet on question datasets generated by each respective model to test whether models have an unfair advantage when evaluating or answering text they generated themselves.

Analyzing the frequency distribution of correct answer options in synthetically generated multiple-choice questions to detect if the generating model has a skewed tendency to favor a specific answer position (e.g., defaulting to the second option).
